definitions.completion: Completed, auto-applied, automated verification passed, browser QA passed, and all milestones completed.
definitions.tokens: Sum provider-reported per-call usage. All calls in both runs had reported token counts.
definitions.runtime: Run finishedAt - createdAt; excludes post-run independent QA and report writing.
definitions.humanIntervention: Manual stops and manual resumes recorded after run creation. Post-run QA is reported separately.
definitions.completionRate: Observed completed runs divided by runs started; n=1 per configuration and not a population estimate.

single.reason: Planning ended before milestone creation: required observable completion criteria were missing.

loop.reason: Reached the 20-round ceiling with styling-responsive and final-integration-qa incomplete.

loopWorkspace.scope: Partial Loop workspace only; not evidence of automatic final completion.

manualBrowserSmoke.method: Visible Codex in-app browser UI actions against the preserved Loop workspace served on localhost after the run.
passedBehaviors: Initial empty state and zero summaries displayed.
Title, subject, and minutes could be submitted with Enter; task count and status updated.
Completing a task updated state and progress to 100%.
Active filter hid the completed task and Completed filter showed it.
Undo restored the active state and 0% progress.
Title and subject search each found the task.
Reload preserved the task in local storage.
Delete restored the empty state and focused the title field.
Empty submission announced title and minutes errors and focused the title field.
manualBrowserSmoke.criteriaMismatch: A blank subject was accepted. The frozen common browser contract expects subject validation, so that contract criterion is not met by this partial output.
manualBrowserSmoke.viewportEvidence: Narrow in-app browser rendering was visually inspected and showed no visible horizontal overflow. Exact 1440x900 and 390x844 viewport measurements were not performed.

setupAttemptsExcludedFromComparatorRows.reason: Raw Node server did not include the desktop browser QA bridge; cancelled before implementation.
A stale in-memory engine retained the old 10-round ceiling; cancelled after detection.

cost.reason: No reliable per-run monetary billing data was exposed; token counts were not converted to dollars.

security: Credential values are not stored in this evidence file.
